UPDATE TQP_WAFER_SUM SET LOT_SEQ = :LOT_SEQ, PROGRAM = :PROGRAM, PROBE_CNT = :PROBE_CNT WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :WAFER_SEQ
UPDATE TQP_WAFER_SUM SET MAP_CFG_SEQ = :configseq WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :waferseq
UPDATE TQP_WAFER_SUM SET PROBE_CNT = PROBE_CNT + 1 WHERE LOT_SEQ = :LOT_SEQ AND WAFER_ID IN ( SELECT WAFER_ID FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :WAFER_SEQ )
